notes: Two blocks Walnut-Main: 6th to Government Square (with U.S. Custom House & Post Office) and Government Square to 4th. GOVERNMENT (PATTERSON ALLEY) PL., 20', runs Walnut to Main (T at both ends; no continuation across either street). GOVERNMENT SQUARE is the 130' widening of 5th St between Walnut and Main, open roadway with no esplanade; its north edge lines up with E 5th east of Main but it is widened to the south, so at Main there are two T's: Government Square (axis y~2560) from the west and E 5th St (66 ft, axis y~2449, block on sheet 121) from the east. At Walnut it meets Fountain Square (sheet 119), which is nearly aligned, so recorded as one cross at the middle of the four corners. CHURCH PL. runs Walnut to Main: printed 15' at the Walnut end, 18' between Wolf and Druggist, 10' east of Druggist (north side steps south). WOLF ALLEY (10') and DRUGGIST ALLEY (printed ALLEY with DRUGGIST, 10') run Government Square to Church Pl. Berning Alley (named on sheet 116) enters 4th from the south at x~2056. Unnamed alley stub ~20 ft wide north of 6th at x~2021 (block on sheet 132), only its south end on this sheet.
